headline: Noboa announces increase of Ecuador's minimum wage to $500 for 2027
summary: President Daniel Noboa announced a rise in Ecuador's minimum wage to $500 for 2027. The announcement came five days before local elections.
why: Minimum wage changes alter labour costs for employers across Ecuador's economy, including its large retail and services sectors.
original_headline: Noboa anuncia aumento del salario mínimo en Ecuador a 500 dólares para 2027
